audit_summary: Reconciliation of diagnostic seed usage across all Latent Motor Repertoire Atlas artifacts. Explains the discrepancy between the allocated development namespace (20000..20049, N=50) and empirical per-script execution batches.

sensory_motor_matrix.json.rationale: Swept 20 sensory channels x 9 motor populations (180 conditions) for 30 ticks each; batched across 10 representative seeds within the 20000-series namespace.

structural_reachability.json.rationale: Full 3-hop directed BFS on the static 10.5M edge fly-brain connectome graph. Deterministic and invariant to pseudorandom seeds.

classification.json.exact_seeds: N/A (synthesized from sensory_motor_matrix N=10, reachability, and direct viability)
classification.json.rationale: Cross-artifact classification combining functional matrix (N=10), structural reachability, and direct output viability.

bilateral_symmetry.json.rationale: Computes bilateral asymmetry index |L-R|/(L+R) from sensory_motor_matrix.json (N=10) and structural_reachability.json.

dynamics_bottlenecks.json.rationale: High-frequency biophysical sampling (inp, theta, a, tau, rmax, A, u) during steady-state sensory drive across 15 top mismatches.

direct_output_viability.json.rationale: Directly forced descending neuron firing rates across 3 test rates (5, 15, 30 Hz) to test CandidateBridge response; deterministic readout given fixed DN rates.

intermediate_rescue.json.rationale: Evaluated 5 target pathways x 3 intermediate candidates x 5 stimulation rates (5, 10, 20, 30, 40 Hz) across 5 seeds for 40 ticks each.

reconciliation_conclusion: The 20000..20049 (N=50) namespace was formally allocated and reserved in the research plan to prevent any collision with Lane 1 (18000/19000-series). Specific diagnostic tasks executed subsets of that reserved range (N=10 for sensory-motor matrix, N=5 for rescue, N=3 for bottleneck sampling, N=1 for direct readout). The Phase 3 validation phase will freeze a dedicated high-confidence panel and validate it over an expanded fresh namespace: 20200..20299 (N=100).
